title: Scorpion Belfast

description: The Scorpion EXO Scorpion Belfast pairs retro roadster charm with modern multi-density cranial protection, pairing 180-degree panoramic sightlines with certified cranial protection. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing a featherweight 1127g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~97 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks.
